name: s81su_qbt_ref-v5-COMMIT
purpose: QB tap v5 (v4 CLOSED TT +101.46 / FF +11.81, 26 endpoints 4 levels behind the dn_st / dn_v pins): every input pin on its own flop in RTL (pin flop q_d + output flop e_d: 2 x 8,192 b, one cycle deeper), kit recipe 2 (pin flops and hold stages FIRM at the pins, hold 30 ps); same outline 572.4 x 453.6, same pins and io_tcl (bit i in/out on one track, every second track)

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_su_t_qbt u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_suhc/hier/dsfd_su_t_qb.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_suhc/hier/ot_s81_su_qb.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81su_qbt_ref/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81su_qbt_ref/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81su_qbt_ref --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_su_t_qbt  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
